policies.name: profiles_select_own
policies.statement: create policy profiles_select_own on public.profiles for select to authenticated using ((select auth.uid()) = id);

policies.name: profiles_update_own
policies.statement: create policy profiles_update_own on public.profiles for update to authenticated using ((select auth.uid()) = id) with check ((select auth.uid()) = id);

policies.name: categories_select_authenticated
policies.statement: create policy categories_select_authenticated on public.categories for select to authenticated using (true);

policies.name: events_select_authenticated
policies.statement: create policy events_select_authenticated on public.events for select to authenticated using (organizer_id = (select auth.uid()) or (visibility = 'public' and cancelled_at is null and archived_at is null));

policies.name: events_insert_own
policies.statement: create policy events_insert_own on public.events for insert to authenticated with check (organizer_id = (select auth.uid()) and visibility = 'public' and cancelled_at is null and archived_at is null);

policies.name: event_images_select_visible
policies.statement: create policy event_images_select_visible on public.event_images for select to authenticated using (exists (select 1 from public.events where id = event_id));

policies.name: files_select_visible
policies.statement: create policy files_select_visible on public.files for select to authenticated using (uploaded_by = (select auth.uid()) or exists (select 1 from public.event_images where file_id = files.id));

policies.name: files_insert_own
policies.statement: create policy files_insert_own on public.files for insert to authenticated with check (uploaded_by = (select auth.uid()));

policies.name: event_images_insert_own
policies.statement: create policy event_images_insert_own on public.event_images for insert to authenticated with check ( exists (select 1 from public.events where id = event_id and organizer_id = (select auth.uid())) );

policies.name: event_media_select_visible
policies.statement: create policy event_media_select_visible on storage.objects for select to authenticated using (bucket_id = 'event_media' and ( split_part(name, '/', 1) = (select auth.uid())::text or exists (select 1 from public.files where bucket_name = bucket_id and storage_path = name) ));

policies.name: participations_select_own
policies.statement: create policy participations_select_own on public.event_participations for select to authenticated using (user_id = (select auth.uid()));

policies.name: participation_history_select_own
policies.statement: create policy participation_history_select_own on public.participation_history for select to authenticated using (exists (select 1 from public.event_participations p where p.id = participation_id));

policies.name: events_select_participating
policies.statement: create policy events_select_participating on public.events for select to authenticated using (exists (select 1 from public.event_participations p where p.event_id = events.id));

policies.name: conversations_read_member
policies.statement: create policy conversations_read_member on public.conversations for select to authenticated using (planit_private.can_read_event_chat(event_id));

policies.name: messages_read_member
policies.statement: create policy messages_read_member on public.messages for select to authenticated using (exists (select 1 from public.conversations c where c.id = conversation_id));

policies.name: notifications_read_own
policies.statement: create policy notifications_read_own on public.notifications for select to authenticated using (recipient_id = (select auth.uid()));

policies.name: notifications_mark_own
policies.statement: create policy notifications_mark_own on public.notifications for update to authenticated using (recipient_id = (select auth.uid())) with check (recipient_id = (select auth.uid()));

policies.name: event_media_delete_unlinked
policies.statement: create policy event_media_delete_unlinked on storage.objects for delete to authenticated using (bucket_id = 'event_media' and planit_private.can_delete_event_upload(name));

policies.name: event_media_insert_own
policies.statement: create policy event_media_insert_own on storage.objects for insert to authenticated with check ( bucket_id = 'event_media' and split_part(name,'/',1) = (select auth.uid())::text and split_part(name,'/',2) ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' and not exists(select 1 from public.events where id::text = split_part(name,'/',2) and organizer_id <> (select auth.uid())) );

policies.name: rejoin_requests_select_own
policies.statement: create policy rejoin_requests_select_own on public.event_rejoin_requests for select to authenticated using (exists (select 1 from public.event_participations p where p.id = participation_id and p.user_id = (select auth.uid())));
